name: The Bounty of Teldrassil
summary: Nessa Shadowsong is sending fish samples from Rut'theran Village to Auberdine for comparison. She wants to learn whether Teldrassil's fish are larger and more plentiful than those along the mainland coast.

sections.title: A Fisherman's Study
sections.body: Nessa Shadowsong asks you to carry fish bones and scales to Laird in Auberdine. Fishers in Rut'theran Village bring in large, plentiful catches, and she wants to know whether the mainland waters yield the same kind of fish. The samples will let Laird compare the island catch with fish from the coast of Darkshore.

sections.title: Arranging Passage
sections.body: Nessa Shadowsong sends you to Vesprystus, the hippogryph master in Rut'theran Village, with the collection for Auberdine. Carrying the samples to him arranges your passage across the water to Darkshore.

faq.q: What is Nessa trying to investigate?
faq.answer: Nessa Shadowsong wants to compare the large, plentiful fish caught around Rut'theran Village with fish from the mainland coast of Darkshore. She sends bones and scales for that comparison.

faq.q: Who is receiving the fish samples in Auberdine?
faq.answer: Nessa Shadowsong sends the collection to Laird, a fish vendor in Auberdine.

faq.q: Why take the parcel to Vesprystus instead of traveling directly to Auberdine?
faq.answer: Vesprystus is the hippogryph master in Rut'theran Village. Nessa directs you to give him the collection to arrange passage across the water to Darkshore.

faq.q: Where is Rut'theran Village located in relation to Teldrassil?
faq.answer: Rut'theran Village sits at the southern base of Teldrassil, at sea level. An emerald portal connects it to Darnassus, and it is a harbor for ships and hippogryphs traveling to and from the great tree.

faq.q: What happens after giving the collection to Vesprystus?
faq.answer: After Vesprystus accepts the collection, he offers Flight to Auberdine, which takes you across the strait on a hippogryph to Darkshore.

faq.q: Is this part of leaving the starting zone for Night Elves?
faq.answer: Yes. This chain introduces young night elf adventurers to flight paths and guides them from Teldrassil to Darkshore, where they continue their journeys.

angles.text: For night elf travelers, the journey leads from the heights of Teldrassil to the mainland shores of Darkshore.
For the Alliance, the route between Rut'theran and Auberdine links the night elf capital with the rest of northern Kalimdor.
